messages:
Ava: Heads-up from the partner canary  lots of fncall validation rejects. Most are extra optional fields; partners expect permissive. Need clearer metric split.
Rohan: Which validator flag did we flip?
Ava: strict-validator=true on canary routes. It returns hard rejects right now.
Claire: Can we emit coarse_metric outcome=ok|soft|hard so Prom labels stay low-cardinality?
Tomas: Yes. Keep detailed reason out of Prom. Emit reason_id (short hash) + sample_id to traces/events.
Rohan: Good. Sampling note: partner traffic is 60% of volume so uniform sampling hides other customers. Use stratified sampling by customer_id with a small floor.
Ava: Also product wants billing visibility for soft-degraded tokens  separate meter `billing.soft_degraded_tokens`.
Claire: Prom team: outcome label is 3 values only. No free-text reasons as labels.
Tomas: UX asks: add panel with three series (ok/soft/hard), heatmap of (route,outcome) pairs, and sample-rate overlay. Add annotation when flag flips.
devex-bot: Doc stub created: https://internal.docs/redwood/observability/fncall-outcomes  please review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for eng-platform/exporter#317  awaiting reviews.
Ava: Action owners: Tomas  sampler + reason_id; Rohan  exporter metric change + billing tag; Claire  dashboard + annotations. I'll coordinate canary start after PR merges.
